fullPassage: One could say that judging or pre-judging is natural and necessary for protection and safety, but there are times that it just doesn't apply. There are an infinite number of examples and ways in which we judge daily, and we have to distinguish what type of judging we are doing. It's very easy to judge somebody else's choices, relationship, parenting style, condition of their home, finances, and everything else, but there's a reason for almost everything. If we look past the surface, we may see a deeper problem that warrants some understanding, empathy, or even enlightenment on our part. I have judged people based on what they had on, where they lived, their accent, their financial status, or their behavior, but my perception and judgement didn't make it true. Now, I immediately check myself and say, "Girl, STOP!"

questions.passage: One could say that judging or pre-judging is natural and necessary for protection and safety, but there are times that it just doesn't apply. There are an infinite number of examples and ways in which we judge daily, and we have to distinguish what type of judging we are doing. It's very easy to judge somebody else's choices, relationship, parenting style, condition of their home, finances, and everything else, but there's a reason for almost everything. If we ____, we may see a deeper problem that warrants some understanding, empathy, or even enlightenment on our part. I have judged people based on what they had on, where they lived, their accent, their financial status, or their behavior, but my perception and judgement didn't make it true. Now, I immediately check myself and say, "Girl, STOP!"
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 표면 너머를 보다(look past the surface).
det.analysis:
✅ ① look past the surface: '표면 너머를 본다면' 더 깊은 문제를 볼 수 있다는 원문 표현.
❌ ② ignore the consequences: '결과를 무시하다'는 맥락과 다름.
❌ ③ blame them harshly: '그들을 가혹하게 비난하다'는 공감/이해와 반대.
❌ ④ hide our feelings: '감정을 숨기다'는 내용과 무관.
det.tip: look past the surface(겉모습 너머를 보다) — 겉모습이 아닌 본질을 보라는 메시지.

questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.analysis:
✅ ④ check myself: '나를 자제시키다/돌아보다'로 원문 그대로. 판단을 멈추라는 경고.
❌ ① trust my instincts: '본능을 믿다'는 반성과 반대.
❌ ② confront others boldly: '대담하게 맞서다'는 맥락과 무관.
❌ ③ judge more carefully: '더 신중히 판단하다'는 판단을 멈추라는 의도와 다름.
det.tip: check oneself(스스로를 돌아보다, 자제하다) — 판단을 멈추고 반성하는 행위.
